title: Moon boat
text:
The moon is a boat on the dark blue sea,
sailing so slowly, as quiet as can be.
Its silver sail shines in the night,
and the stars are the fish that dart left and right.

The wind is the captain who steers it along,
humming the words of a sleepy song.
The clouds are the waves that rock it to sleep,
and the owls are the sailors who watch and keep.

When morning comes, the boat sails away,
over the edge of the new bright day.
But I know that tonight, if I look up high,
it will sail once again through the sky.
